activities.title: Arithmetic progressions: the same difference every step
Geometric progressions: the same ratio every step

assessmentPoints: Opening answers in the arithmetic activity
Formula lines in the toolkit recap
successCriteria: I can write u_n = a + (n - 1)d for an arithmetic progression and u_n = a x r^(n - 1) for a geometric progression
I can count the jumps from u_1, not the terms
objectives.text: Write the nth term of an arithmetic progression, u_n = a + (n - 1)d, and of a geometric progression, u_n = a x r^(n - 1)

assessmentPoints: Sum answers in the sum-building activity
successCriteria: I can find a partial sum of an arithmetic or geometric progression
I can state the condition |r| < 1 for a sum to infinity and use S = a / (1 - r)
objectives.text: Find partial sums of arithmetic and geometric progressions, and the sum to infinity of a geometric progression when |r| < 1

assessmentPoints: Responses when the trap is sprung
Exit responses in the toolkit activity
successCriteria: I can explain why u_10 = u_1 + 9d, not u_1 + 10d
I can explain why a geometric progression with r = -1 has no sum to infinity
objectives.text: Count jumps, not terms: the nth term sits n - 1 jumps from the first term

title: JC H2 sequences: arithmetic and geometric progressions
